<p>“So… starting next week, I’ll be working as an instructor at the training academy.”</p><p>“Hmm… so you’ll be staying there?”</p><p>“Yeah… but I’ll come home every two days, so don’t worry.”</p><p>“I’m not worried. I trust you… just take care of yourself, okay?”</p><p>“Mhm.”</p><p>My new handler had recommended the Hunter Training Academy instructor position to me.</p><p>I didn’t know if the new handler had heard something from the previous one or if they were just naturally kind, but they arranged multiple jobs for me and explained the pros and cons of each request in detail.</p><p>Having a competent handler finally put my mind at ease.</p><p>To be honest, among all the jobs the handler recommended, the training academy instructor position had the lowest priority.</p><p>The handler said that while the mission risk for an instructor training cadets was practically zero, the pay was correspondingly low. Plus, since few A-rank Hunters wanted to be instructors, the position was always open.</p><p>Back when I was a trainee, being an instructor was a pretty popular job. But now, with Hunters’ value skyrocketing, the salary difference between then and now wasn’t that big, so the instructor role had naturally become a job nobody wanted.</p><p>‘A monthly salary of 30 million won…’</p><p>If I complained about this salary to office workers, I’d probably get slapped across the face for fraud and decapitated before my head was hung at Gwanghwamun. But an A-rank Hunter clearing a single B-rank Gate could earn more than an instructor’s annual salary in one go.</p><p>In other words, for an A-rank Hunter, the pay really was pitiful.</p><p>According to the handler, half of the current instructors were genuinely passionate about teaching, while the other half just didn’t want to enter Gates and only needed enough money to live comfortably.</p><p>So why had I chosen this job out of all the available requests?</p><p>The answer was right here, in this moment.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290796" loading="lazy">
</p><p>Chuup, jup.</p><p>“So… you work two days and rest two days?”</p><p>“No, it’s Monday-Tuesday, then Thursday-Friday off, then Friday-Saturday work, Sunday off…”</p><p>That was a lie.</p><p>It was actually Monday, Tuesday, Friday—three days a week. The Saturday shift was the lie.</p><p>I planned to just book a nearby hotel and rest that day.</p><p>“Honey… I’m going to put it in now… just lie back and relax… hngh.”</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290797" loading="lazy">
</p><p>Yu-na gently pushed my shoulders, laying me down on the bed.</p><p>Ever since we got back from the hotel, every day had been like this.</p><p>I was just fighting a nightly defensive battle against three women.</p><p>I was reaching my limit.</p><p>Na-hyeon would start commuting to the Hunter Association next week, and Ji-hyeon was slowly moving her things into the dorm and would start attending university soon.</p><p>Once that happened, having sex every day like this would be impossible. So I held onto the hope that we could return to the good old days when we only had sex when the mood struck.</p><p>Up until then, I had been gritting my teeth and enduring it, but then I overheard three women chatting at a table.</p><p>“So… every other weekend with Na-hyeon unni and oppa, and the other week with me…”</p><p>“How are you gonna do that in the dorm?”</p><p>“There are motels all over the place near school, so…”</p><p>“What about your mom?”</p><p>“Yeah, I get her all to myself on weekdays, so…”</p><p>“So jealous…”</p><p>Why didn’t they ask *me* if it was okay?</p><p>Before I knew it, I was pressing my ear to the door, eavesdropping on their conversation, my teeth grinding.</p><p>This couldn’t go on. At this rate, I’d be drained dry by Yu-na on weekdays and then sold off to Na-hyeon and Ji-hyeon every other weekend to be used as a living dildo.</p><p>In the end, I chose to take a job as a training camp instructor so I could get out of the house.</p><p>Squish squelch squish</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290798" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“Y-Yeahhh! I love you! Feels so good! Ohhh!”</p><p>“Huuu…!”</p><p>Am I tired of this life? Hell no, it’s fucking amazing.</p><p>But just because it’s good doesn’t mean it’s not exhausting.</p><p>After spending half my life alone, this kind of routine was just too much for me.</p><p>Every night, I’d take turns having wild sex with the three women, and in the morning, I’d do it again with whoever was still at home. Like right now.</p><p>At first, everything had been thrilling and new, but now it was starting to feel numb.</p><p>But I also knew myself too well—I was the embodiment of lust. So I concluded that if I could see them every other day, I’d be able to throw myself into it passionately again.</p><p>***</p><p>“Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon…”</p><p>“Ah, yes. Hello. Thank you as always.”</p><p>The driver was waiting for me with the back door open.</p><p>Today, I was finally starting my new job as an instructor at the training camp.</p><p>It wasn’t the same training camp where I’d trained, but the thought of returning to one still felt strange.</p><p>“Are you tired, Hunter-nim?”</p><p>The driver glanced at me in the rearview mirror a few times as he drove before speaking.</p><p>I guess the all-night orgy with the three women as my grand finale before heading to the training camp showed on my face.</p><p>“Haha… I couldn’t sleep well. Going back to the training camp just feels surreal.”</p><p>“I see. Close your eyes. I’ll wake you when we arrive.”</p><p>“Yes, thank you.”</p><p>Thanks to the driver’s kindness, I gently closed my eyes.</p><p>The subject I was assigned to teach was practical combat.</p><p>Since assigning an A-rank Hunter to anything other than combat would be a waste of talent, most A-rank instructors ended up in combat-related subjects.</p><p>On top of that, the class I was in charge of was the regular trainee class.</p><p>‘This’ll be a piece of cake.’</p><p>It wasn’t that I was ignoring them, but compared to the special class, they really were easier to teach.</p><p>After all, most of these trainees would end up as D or E-rank Hunters, so there was no need to go overboard with the training.</p><p>There was even a joke going around that the most important thing taught in the general class was how to run away.</p><p>‘They said another instructor from Central HQ is coming besides me…’</p><p>I asked the supervisor who it was, but all they knew was that the person was an A-rank Hunter. Nothing else.</p><p>I’d heard that being an instructor wasn’t popular because the pay was low for the risk, but on the flip side, the supervisor was struggling with a shortage of staff. From their perspective, if a Hunter under their supervision became an instructor, it counted as a good performance record.</p><p>The supervisor had sincerely thanked me for it.</p><p>‘This supervisor’s not bad…’</p><p>***</p><p>“Instructor! Your identity verification is complete. Here’s your ID. We’ll deliver your instructor uniform to your quarters.”</p><p>“Are we training today?”</p><p>“No, since today is your first day, you can rest up. Training will start tomorrow. Today’s session was led by the new instructor who arrived from Central HQ yesterday.”</p><p>“Ah, right. I heard another instructor was coming. Where can I meet them?”</p><p>“Ah… the instructor… huh? U-um…”</p><p>The Association staff member guiding me suddenly stopped talking and stared past my shoulder.</p><p>When I turned around, I saw a familiar face—no, someone I might know better than I thought.</p><p>“Huh…”</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290799" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“Oh, it’s been a while… Seong-hyeon.”</p><p>“Y-yeah. Long time no see.”</p><p>Standing there, dressed in training clothes as if she had just finished a session, was Min Se-rin.</p><p>“W-well, since you and I are next-door neighbors, I’ll show you to your room!”</p><p>“Ah, Instructor Min, would you? Then…”</p><p>The staff member bowed and left, leaving just the two of us.</p><p>We hadn’t been in contact since that day, and this was our first time seeing each other in a while, so the air between us was awkward.</p><p>“Seong-hyeon, I’ll take you to your room, then…”</p><p>“Okay.”</p><p>As we walked in silence, broken only by the sound of our footsteps, I couldn’t hold back any longer and spoke first.</p><p>“S-Se-rin… why on earth are *you* an instructor…?”</p><p>I couldn’t shake the uneasy thought—what if she had come here *because* she heard I was going to be an instructor?</p><p>Please, let this just be my overactive imagination, I silently prayed as I asked the question.</p><p>“Ah…! Well, there aren’t many Hunters applying to be instructors these days, so Central HQ is dispatching us as… like, special temporary instructors…”</p><p>“So you won’t be doing it for long?”</p><p>“Probably… around two months…”</p><p>“···.”</p><p>Thankfully, it seemed my paranoia had been unfounded.</p><p>“Oh… the room is nice…”</p><p>As expected of an A-rank Hunter instructor, the quarters were in excellent condition.</p><p>It was a two-room setup with a separate shower, kitchen, living room, and bedroom.</p><p>“Y-yes… The other instructors are staying in the dorms next door. Those are full, so on this floor, it’s just the two of us…”</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>“Uh, well, get some rest! See you tomorrow!”</p><p>Min Se-rin ended it there and retreated into her own room.</p><p>For some reason, a chill ran down my spine.</p><p>Min Se-rin’s complexion had improved far more than before. It seemed the sex ed session we’d had that day… had actually helped. That was a relief.</p><p>She no longer seemed to lose sleep or live under the weight of guilt.</p><p>So there shouldn’t be any reason for us to get tangled up again. But then, thinking of Ohana, a thought crossed my mind… maybe, *just maybe*, there *were* a tiny number of trainees like that.</p><p>“I should call Yu-na and take a nap…”</p><p>How long had it been since I left home, and already I missed the sound of Yu-na’s voice.</p><p>‘This was the right call…’</p><p>Distance really did make the heart grow fonder.
